topic: OmniScientist paper-to-public-release chronology and artifact identity

derived_scope_limited_finding.claim: The first observed packaged OmniScientist release postdates arXiv v1 by three days. Release assets provide useful immutable distribution hashes, but release identity alone cannot establish the exact implementation bytes used for the paper's 36-case evaluation. An evaluated-run provenance claim therefore still requires a paper-run manifest or an explicit authorship binding from the evaluated artifact to a source/release revision.
derived_scope_limited_finding.scope: Observed GitHub release chronology only; no claim that authors lacked or failed to preserve their internal evaluated revision.

protocol_relation: Strengthens the existing revision/provenance rule: public release hashes are distribution identities, not retroactive evaluated-run identities.
